scripts.format: npm run format:go && npm run format:web
scripts.format:check: npm run format:go:check && npm run format:web:check
scripts.lint: npm run lint:go && npm run lint:web
scripts.contracts:check: node scripts/generate-tokens.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-i18n.mjs --check && node --test scripts/generate-assets.test.mjs && npm run sdk:generate -- --check
scripts.test: go test ./... -count=1 && npm run test:main -w apps/desktop && npm run test:renderer -w apps/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop && npm run build:main -w apps/desktop
scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run contracts:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run desktop:build
